subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 12 updates

question: After the three stale assertions are synchronized on the final rebased head, should OpenClaw approve these twelve exact third-party action revisions for workflows that handle secrets, publishing, and security scanning?
rationale: The functional repair is mechanical, but accepting new executable third-party commits at these permission boundaries requires maintainer intent and cannot be safely inferred from green checks alone.

options.title: Repair and approve
options.body: Synchronize the assertions, rebase once, validate the exact head, and approve the verified immutable action commits.

options.title: Recreate the group
options.body: Close and recreate the grouped Dependabot update if repeated rebases cannot retain the required assertion repairs on a stable head.

recommendation.title: Repair and approve
recommendation.body: Synchronize the assertions, rebase once, validate the exact head, and approve the verified immutable action commits.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the strongest ownership signal across the affected workflow guards, token permissions, and publication automation.
